title: An ActiveSync device from setup to push
alt: The person types an email address and password. Autodiscover (POX, SOAP or JSON) gives the ActiveSync address. OPTIONS lists versions 14.1 and 16.1; Provision hands over a policy; FolderSync lists mail folders, calendars, address books, task lists and notes; Sync brings each folder up to date; Ping then waits until something changes, and the device syncs that folder and pings again.

nodes.text: Email address and password typed on the device
Autodiscover (POX, SOAP or JSON) answers with https://<host>/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync
Provision: a policy without device rules
FolderSync: mail folders, calendars, address books, task lists, notes
Sync each folder: mail from Hearth Mail's store, the rest from Nextcloud
Ping waits up to the heartbeat
Answer: nothing changed; the device pings again
